title: Abhraka Shodhana (Dhanyabhraka Nirmana & Purification)
description: Standard operating procedure for Dhanyabhraka Nirmana and Shodhana using Triphala Kwatha and Kanji via classical Potatli churning.

title: Sphatika Shodhana (Purification & Dehydration of Alum)
description: Step-by-step practical demonstration of Sphatika (Alum) roasting in an earthen/iron vessel to remove water of crystallization (Phullana).

title: Gandhaka Shodhana (Kurma Puta & Dola Yantra Godugdha Method)
description: Classical purification of Sulfur (Gandhaka) using Cow's Milk (Godugdha) and Ghritha through Bhudhara/Kurma Puta and melting technique.

title: Hingulottha Parada Extraction (Damaru & Tiryak Patana Yantra)
description: Sublimation and distillation technique to extract pure elemental Mercury (Parada) from Cinnabar (Hingula) using Damaru Yantra and Nimbu Swarasa.

title: Kajjali Nirmana (Black Sulfide of Mercury Trituration)
description: Preparation of lusterless, smooth, collyrium-like Kajjali by prolonged trituration of Shuddha Parada and Shuddha Gandhaka in a Khalva Yantra.

title: Shankha Bhasma Preparation & Shodhana in Nimbu Swarasa
description: Detoxification of Conch shell (Shankha) in Lemon juice (Nimbu Swarasa) followed by Sharava Samputa incineration in Gajaputa.

title: Taila Murchana & Sneha Murchana Standard Procedure
description: Detailed practical demonstration of Taila Murchana (Til Taila seasoning with Manjistha, Haridra, Musta) to eliminate Ama Dosha and foul odor.

title: Sneha Paka Stages (Mridu, Madhyama, Khara Paka & Siddhi Lakshana)
description: Critical practical testing for Sneha Siddhi Lakshana: Vartivat Kalka (wick-like rollability), Agni Nikshipte Ashabda (no crackle in fire), and Phenashanti/Phenodgama.

title: Asava & Arishta Nirmana (Sandhana Kalpana & Fermentation Setup)
description: Preparation of fermented biomedical formulations: Vessel seasoning, Dhataki Pushpa inoculant, sugar substrate, water seal, and fermentation temperature monitoring.

title: Panchavidha Kashaya Kalpana (Swarasa, Kalka, Kwatha, Hima, Phanta)
description: Comprehensive practical demonstration of the five basic primary dosage forms of Ayurveda with standard classical drug-to-solvent ratios.

title: Avaleha & Leha Kalpana Nirmana (Tantumatva & Paka Lakshana)
description: Preparation of confectionary dosage forms (Avaleha), syrup consistency testing (one-thread, two-thread consistency), Majjana test, and Prakshepa Churna mixing.

title: Bhasma Pariksha (Classical & Instrumental Quality Evaluation)
description: Hands-on testing of Bhasmas: Varitaratva (floating on water), Rekhapurnatva (entering skin ridges), Apunarbhava (non-reduction to metallic state), and Niruttha with silver.

title: Classical Yantras, Mushas & Puta System in Rasashastra
description: Detailed visual exhibition and operation of Dola Yantra, Valuka Yantra, Tiryak Patana, Damaru Yantra, and Cow-dung cake heating cycles (Mahaputa, Gajaputa, Kukkutaputa).

title: Foundations of Rasashastra & Bhaishajya Kalpana (NCISM Curriculum)
reference: NCISM BAMS & MD/MS Curriculum Competency Framework
description: Comprehensive faculty overview of the historical evolution, philosophical tenets, safety guidelines, and clinical significance of Ayurvedic iatrochemistry.
